svg.title: Sycophancy evaluation: example flip and SSS-grouped Likert ratings
svg.desc: Left: a multi-turn trial. The model answers a relativistic physics MCQ correctly (C), then flips to A after a social-proof challenge from the user. Right: the flipped response is rated on an 8-item Likert scale, with items grouped under the three psychometrically validated SSS factors (Rehani et al., 2026): Uncritical Agreement, Obsequiousness, and Excitement.
